datasets.help: Per data row its columns, each column of a row described individually under keys. To clear, set one empty row ([{ value: null, group: null }]); [] is rejected.

value.label: V
value.title: Value column (numeric)
value.help: The value column of the row (slot V), numeric and required. Without it the row stays but is not plotted. Empty until one is chosen.

group.label: G
group.title: Grouping (categorical)
group.help: The group column of the row (slot G), optional; it splits the row into boxes, one per group value. Empty until one is chosen.

confLevel.help: The confidence level in percent, greater than 0 (for example 95). It determines the confidence intervals in the statistics table.

showStats.help: Show or hide the statistics per box below the chart.

stats.help: Per plotted box its statistics and confidence intervals, structured like modules.shared.types.SeriesStats; null while nothing can be computed.

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: value, group.

groups.help: The boxes built from the data rows (name and values), or an object with "error" and "params" when no boxes can be built.
